violation_type.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that child was left unattended, and caregiver was not at a physical proximity which did not allow visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

finding_variants.text: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that child was left unattended, and caregiver was not at a physical proximity which did not allow visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.
Children displayed inappropriate behavior during outdoor play as a result of lack of supervision by caregivers.
During the walkthrough, it was oberved that a classroom contained ten children who were unsupervised by a staff member. This was corrected during the inspection a staff memeber joined the class.
Two children were running around in circles on the stage, and one hit his head on a metal, mounted speaker box. The caregiver saw them running and did not intervene.
Protocol was not appropriately followed and a child was left on the playground for a few minutes without supervision.
A child was unsupervised in the cafeteria, accessed a caregiver's pepper spray, and sprayed it into their eyes.
